set.description: Core chat transport (send_message + streaming background-task lifecycle) and chat metadata commands.
Gateway social connections, gateway supervisor control and remote target (SSH/Docker) management commands.
Surface identity, in-app CLI install, update checks and mobile pairing commands.
Speech-to-text (cloud + local whisper) and whisper model catalog commands.
Session CRUD/branch/export, slash/rewind/feedback, skill loop and interactive-permission commands.
File inspection (tree, diffs, attachments) and LSP code-action commands.
MCP server management, extension/skill/agent/data-source installers and plugin marketplace commands.
Agent definitions, sub-agent registry and inter-agent message commands.
Scheduled tasks, routines, triage, inbox, goal/batch runs and hook permission-profile commands.
Usage statistics, session budgets/cost breakdown and billing commands.
Session multi-window lifecycle and draggable workspace layout commands.
Native OS notification bridge and onboarding seed commands.
Dev-server preview, migration wizard, persona packs and integrated terminal commands.
